LEGL 1000.title: Legal Education (Basic Law, National Security Law and Safeguarding National Security Ordinance)
LEGL 1000.description: A compulsory legal education course for all undergraduates to learn about the PRC Constitution, Basic Law, National Security Law, Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, and Legal System of HKSAR. Students will gain an understanding on these topics and their relevance to the society. The course is a self-paced online course and will cover the topics in 3 modules. Students will be required to complete and pass an assessment for each module to obtain a "Pass" grade for the course. Graded P or F.
cilos: Have broad understanding of the basic information about Hong Kong’s legal system by introducing the Constitution of the People’s Republic of China, the Basic Law of Hong Kong SAR.
Understand the different levels of court and the role of the National People’s Congress.
Get the background information of the Hong Kong’s National Security Law.
Define and comprehend the rules and boundaries in public events and introduce the public order offences in Hong Kong.
